evaluations.outcome: incomplete: GitHub Actions API reads for docs.yml runs were rate-limited before at least five comparable successful runs could be collected from the last 14 days, so artifact transfer and Pages packaging could not be re-evaluated safely in this run.

actionable_improvement: among the latest 20 successful docs.yml runs in the last 14 days, docs execution spent a median 44s in build and 54s end-to-end, with dashboard restore itself only 2.0s median. Trusted docs logs confirmed repeated cache hits for the central-agentic-ops-dashboard cache and node_modules, so docs is already reusing the dashboard artifact efficiently. However, trusted cao-dashboard runs that feed that cache still spend 54-59s in Upgrade fallback activity data on every successful push while the actual Assemble Dashboard Language site step takes only 1-5s and artifact upload 7-8s. Those same logs validated and recopied a 361.1 MiB gh-aw-logs.sqlite plus 103 shards / 228.5 MiB into the reusable dashboard artifact before compressing ~34.7 MiB for upload. This makes reusable dashboard generation bottleneck on rebuilding and repackaging the activity database instead of on dashboard rendering. A workflow change that publishes and reuses a pre-upgraded, ready-to-package dashboard input (or otherwise skips Upgrade fallback activity data when the restored activity cache already validates) is expected to save about 55s per cao-dashboard run, which is roughly 57% of that workflow's build job and would remove the dominant source feeding docs dashboard freshness.

no_actionable_improvement: evaluated the latest 20 completed successful docs.yml runs from the last 14 days, with 16 build executions and 4 freshness skips. Trusted job metadata showed Build documentation at 12.5s median and 13.0s p90, versus 43.0s median build-job execution, 65.5s median full workflow wall time, and 11.0s median build queue. Install dependencies was skipped on all 16 build executions because node_modules restore hit every time, and Restore cached CAO Dashboard stayed at 2.0s median with lookup/download steps skipped. The main outliers were Checkout at 27-36s on runs 36741226546 and 36752345073 and deploy/job queue variance, not Astro generation. Astro generation therefore does not meet the >=60s or >=15% actionable savings threshold without weakening correctness or freshness.

no_actionable_improvement: latest 20 completed successful docs.yml runs in the last 14 days included 16 build executions and 4 freshness skips. Trusted job metadata showed Install dependencies and Save node_modules skipped on every built run, while Restore node_modules remained a cache hit with 5s median and 7.5s p90; matching build logs also showed the cached CAO Dashboard restore hitting and skipping dashboard lookup/download. Current medians were 54s full workflow (p90 128.1s), 44.5s build job (p90 59.5s), 23s deploy job on deploying runs (p90 55.7s), 13s Build documentation, 2s Restore cached CAO Dashboard, 7s Upload Pages artifact, and 8.5s schedule-freshness. Dependency installation and cache reuse remain below the 60s or 15% threshold, while the only recurring material waste still visible remains the already-recorded same-SHA workflow_run duplicate rebuild issue #15029.
